             VALUES (?, '1.0.0', '/packages/x', '2026-09-03T00:00:00Z',
                     'https://example.invalid/x.zip', 'ab')
             ON CONFLICT (name, version) DO UPDATE SET name = excluded.name
             RETURNING id
